title: A 'free' menu option ('weigh what each choice would mean', 'get your bearings', etc.) sometimes silently advances the scene/turn counter or reshuffles the menu numbering between pages, making a chosen number occasionally resolve to the wrong listed action (e.g. selecting 'the old king's steel' produced a farewell line instead, and once a page-2 option list caused an unintended 'go north' instead of the intended dialogue pick).
where: The Forge / Captain Vane's Tent multi-page menus
